events.verdict: Chandler (LAL) makes high-five contact with Ross' (ORL) hand after the release of his jump shot attempt.

RLS shows Vucevic (ORL) makes incidental contact to the back of Kuzma's (LAL) head during the rebound. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Ingram (LAL) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball during Augustin's (ORL) drive into the lane.
Caldwell-Pope (LAL) does not beat Fournier (ORL) to the spot and does not establish legal guarding position at the time contact is created.
Vucevic (ORL) is in a wide screening position in Caldwell-Pope's (LAL) defensive path, but contact on the screen occurs to Caldwell-Pope's upper body.
Chandler (LAL) places his right hand to Fournier's (ORL) front and makes marginal contact that does not affect his SQBR.
Chandler (LAL) legally contests Fournier's (ORL) driving shot attempt.
Vucevic (ORL) makes incidental contact with Caldwell-Pope (LAL) during the rebound.
Kuzma (LAL) maintains legal guarding position as Vucevic (ORL) loses control of the ball in the lane.
Fournier (ORL) maintains a wrap on Ingram's (LAL) opposite side hip as he moves to set the pick.
Vucevic (ORL) briefly grasps Chandler's (LAL) shorts as they each attempt to gain rebounding position, but the contact is brief and does not affect Chandler's ability to retrieve the rebound.
Kuzma (LAL) places his left hand against Augustin's (ORL) shoulder and makes marginal contact that does not affect his SQBR during the drive.
Vucevic (ORL) places his left forearm against James' (LAL) front and makes marginal contact that does not affect his SQBR during the drive.
Chandler (LAL) sets the pick on Gordon (ORL) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Ross (ORL) makes incidental foot contact with Chandler (LAL) during the rebound.
Chandler (LAL) sets the screen on Simmons (ORL) at the top of the perimeter and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Chandler (LAL) leaps and makes incidental contact with Isaac (ORL) as he attempts to gain control of the rebound.
